app.title: A Song of Ice and Fire
app.subtitle: World of Ice and Fire Roleplay

chat.emptyTitle: The mists of the known world await
chat.emptyBody: Configure your API connection in Settings, then send the first message to begin. Later milestones add Eras, character creation and the status panel.

conn.title: Connection
conn.apiKeys: API Keys (one per line — rotates on 429/401)
conn.noModels: Not scanned yet — press Scan models or type a model name
conn.corsProxyWarn: Your data will pass through this proxy — only use one you trust.

prompt.noPresets: No presets yet — import an ST Chat Completion preset file to begin.
prompt.inspectorEmpty: Nothing to inspect — send at least one message or select a preset.
prompt.noPresetActive: No active preset — payload is bare history

lore.importHint: ST world_info or character_book format. Multiple sources are merged by insertion_order. This is NOT an editor — edit lore in your usual tool.

params.top_p: Nucleus sampling — keep tokens within cumulative probability p
params.top_k: Only consider the k most likely tokens
params.min_p: Drop tokens below a relative probability threshold
params.top_a: Dynamic threshold based on the strongest token
params.max_context: Context budget — used to trim chat history

terr.notYours: You do not govern this region — you can only see its sovereignty and the controlling House's attitude.
terr.warnFamine: Food running out — {n} months to famine.
terr.warnBesieged: This holding is UNDER SIEGE — hold out for relief or break the siege!
terr.moodHigh: The people of {region} prosper and praise you as a just lord.
terr.moodMid: The people of {region} get by, but watch your every decision.
terr.moodLow: The people of {region} are discontent; grumbling spreads through the alleys.
terr.needCoastal: Only buildable in a coastal holding.
terr.noGarrison: No troops garrisoned in this holding.
terr.garrisonNote: Full troop movement & recruitment opens in Milestone 8.
terr.peopleCalm: Life in the holding is calm. A few small petitions await your judgment.
terr.peopleRestless: The smallfolk are uneasy — disputes and grievances await resolution.
terr.petition: An old farmer, on behalf of the village, begs for lower taxes after a poor harvest.
terr.petitionDeny: Deny it, collect in full (+200 Gold, −Loyalty)
terr.petitionDone: You have ruled. Word of your decision spreads across the holding.

mil.noFleet: You have no fleet. Build a Port in a coastal holding to build ships.
mil.landed: Troops have landed — ready to lay siege.
mil.blockaded: Port blockaded — enemy sea supply cut.
mil.noTroopsAboard: Fleet is not carrying infantry to land.
mil.fleetNote: Landing opens a coastal siege (bypasses land defenses); blockade cuts supply/trade.
mil.captiveNote: Ransom, exchange and treatment are managed in the Intrigue panel.
mil.noUnits: You have no armies yet. Build a Barracks and recruit troops to begin.
mil.moveHint: Pick a destination from the list, or use 'Move on map' and tap a region.
mil.needBarracks: No holding has a Barracks yet — build one to recruit.
mil.recruitNote: Only era-appropriate troops can be recruited; troops need a few months to train.
mil.noHouses: No known Houses to treat with.
mil.diploNote: Declaring war changes legal status; War Score swings with each battle won or lost.

extra.title: Extra Model (Variable Analysis)
extra.desc: Use a secondary model (cheaper/faster) to automatically extract variable updates from the main AI's response when it forgets or uses wrong format.
extra.autoTrigger: Auto-trigger when main AI doesn't return variables
extra.engineMvuZodDesc: AI uses JSON ops in <UpdateVariable>. Type-safe with derived values and cascade effects.
extra.engineAutoDbDesc: AI uses SQL (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) in <tableEdit>. LLMs are often more comfortable with SQL syntax.
extra.engineNote: ℹ Both modes share the same underlying data. Switch anytime without losing state.
